title: opensAt is not an RFC 3339 timestamp
description: opensAt is shaped like a UTC timestamp — it even ends in 'Z', so the pattern requiring UTC passes — but month 13 and hour 99 do not exist, so it is not an RFC 3339 date-time and format: date-time rejects it. Stands in for every date-time-formatted field (postedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, deadlines[].date, provenance.submittedAt, provenance.verifiedAt): an implementation that ignores formats accepts this document and is not conformant. The non-UTC-offset rule has its own case, opensat-non-utc-offset.
